notes: ROUTE: Claude-in-Chrome connector only, one dedicated tab. robots.txt (ikea.com/robots.txt) was read in that tab first: no anthropic-ai / ClaudeBot / Claude-Web / Claude-User / Claude-SearchBot block, no blanket Disallow: / for User-agent: *, and none of the 92 Disallow lines covers /de/ or /cat/. Everything after that was done from the loaded page https://www.ikea.com/de/de/cat/moebel-fu001/ - the category tree from that page's own hydration payload and every count from IKEA's own listing backend called same-origin with fetch() via javascript_tool. No curl / requests / WebFetch / proxy was used at any point. TREE SOURCE: the DE mega-menu tree from script[type=text/hydrate] -> data.config.catalogSlim on the /de/de/cat/ page: 964 unique nodes across 22 top-level departments, each node carrying id / name / url / subs. Note the child key on the DE payload is 'subs', not 'subCategories'. As on the UK store, /de/de/cat/moebel-fu001/ ('Moebel') is a marketing Themes hub - its own hierarchyObjs entry has parent='themes' and subCategories:[] - so it is NOT a real department and was not used as the furniture root. Furniture was assembled from the DE store's real departments: fu002 Tische & Stuehle, 700640 Sofas & Sessel, bm001 Betten & Matratzen, st001 Aufbewahrung & Schraenke, fu004 Bueromoebel & Gamingmoebel, ba001 Badmoebel & Badzubehoer, od001 Outdoor Moebel (od003 Gartenmoebel) and bc001 Babys & Kinder. ka001 (fitted kitchens, appliances, worktops, sinks, taps, mini-kitchens) and st007 (organisers, boxes, baskets) were inspected and excluded as kitchen fixtures and standalone storage goods respectively; the two furniture nodes IKEA files inside them (10471 kitchen islands/trolleys, 16200 pantry shelving) are reached through st001 and are included. QTY METHOD: for every leaf the exact total is productListPage.productCount from sik.search.blue.cdtapps.com/de/de/product-list-page?category=<id>, fetched same-origin from the loaded page. Every single one of the 117 leaves was then verified two ways: (1) full enumeration - /product-list-page/more-products?category=<id>&start=0&end=productCount+50 returned exactly productCount tiles with exactly productCount unique itemNo values (unique product IDs, not href counting); (2) boundary test - start=productCount-1 returned exactly 1 item and start=productCount returned 0 items. All 117 passed both checks, 0 failures. RENDERED HEADER vs PRODUCT COUNT - MEASURED, NOT ASSUMED: IKEA's rendered 'N Produkte' listing header (p.plp-filter-information__total-count) folds a non-product PLANNER TOOL tile into the figure. 78 of the 117 leaves have productListPage.plannerCount 1 or 2. Six DE category pages were actually loaded in the tab and their header text read from the live DOM: Couchtische productCount 45 / header '46 Produkte', Esstische 92 / '93', Sofas 274 / '275', Betten 226 / '227' (all plannerCount 1 or 2), versus Wuerfelregale 79 / '79' and Einbaukleiderschraenke 389 / '389' (plannerCount 0). So on the DE store the offset is exactly +1 whenever plannerCount>0 - note it is +1 even where plannerCount=2 (Esstische, Sofas), so the header is NOT productCount+plannerCount. Two further details worth passing on: the server-delivered HTML of a category page carries the un-inflated number (a raw fetch of couchtische-10716 returns '45 Produkte'); the +1 only appears after client-side hydration injects the planner tile, so an HTTP-only reader of this site would never see the inflation at all. qty here is the enumerated/boundary-proven PRODUCT count, and the header figure is stated inside every evidence string so the orchestrator can reconcile this against the opposite call made on West Elm UK. SANITY CHECKS: the API echoed back category.name and category.url for every id and both matched the node taken from catalogSlim, so no id silently served a parent listing; 61 distinct qty values across 117 leaves spanning 1-389, so no site-wide constant and no suspiciously round display cap; a boundary test proves each total is neither truncated nor inflated. STOPPING RULE / EXCLUSIONS: stopped above nodes that only split by seat count, size, material or series - Esstische -> 'fuer 2/4/6/8/10 Personen', Essgruppen -> same, Sofas -> 2er/3er/Ecksofas/Sofa-Elemente, Sessel -> Textil/Leder/Rattan, Schlafsofas -> 2er/3er/L-Form, Hocker -> Stoff/Leder/Rattan, Betten -> Doppel-/Einzel-/Boxspring-/Polsterbetten. The whole named-series layer under st001>46052 (PAX, BESTA, PLATSA, EKET, IVAR, ELVARLI, BROR, BOAXEL, SKYTTA, JONAXEL, JOSTEIN, TROFAST, OMAR, LASTARE, LADMAKARE, GULDDRAGARE), the bathroom series under ba001>700450 (AENGSJOEN, HAVBAECK, ENHET, NYSJOEN, TAENNFORSEN, HEMNES, VIDVESSEL), the desk systems under fu004>47423 (MITTZON, TROTTEN, IDASEN, RELATERA) and the children's SMASTAD/LASTARE systems were all excluded as component listings. Also excluded: mattresses and mattress bases (bm002, 24827 Lattenroste, 45855, 18724), 24825 Bettpodeste (LYNGOER/FOELUNGEN sprung and slatted bed bases - bedding, not furniture), furniture parts and covers (10664 sofa covers, 31785 legs, 31786 sofa sections, 24822 bed feet, 55997 wardrobe sliding doors, 30572 table tops/frames, 34006 chair frames, 25223 chair covers, 57654 stool covers, 16298 handles), textiles (20542 seat pads, 46400 outdoor cushions, tl003, tl004), standalone storage goods (10550 boxes & baskets, 10797, 19059 under-bed boxes, 20479, 20474 toy storage), wall shelving (10398 Wandregale, 20660 Haengeregale, 20481, 20676 kitchen shelves - Wall Decor's job), bathroom fixtures and mirrors (20723 basins, 20724 taps, 40690 showers, 20490 Badspiegel and its mirror children, 10555 accessories), lighting (16283, 42242, 55033, 10736, 18773), appliances and laundry machines (20826, 20608, 24898 grills), and the fitted-kitchen tree ka003/700292/ 700293/22957/700543/700544. OVERLAPS: IKEA's DE tree lists several nodes under two parents (21825 Esstische under both 700417 Esszimmermoebel and 700675 Tische; 22659 Hocker at department level and under 700417; 10412 Sideboards under st003 and 30454; 20656 Nachttische under bm001 and st004; fu006 Sessel under 700676 and 700640; 47386 Gartenbaenke under 700319 and 700350; 20858 Badrollwagen under fu005 and ba001; 21958 under st001 and od001; 18707/18708/24714/24715/45816/20483/37899 under both their type parent and the children's tree). Each such leaf is emitted exactly once, under its most natural parent, so there are no duplicate rows; the grouping rows 700417 Esszimmermoebel and 30454 Sideboards & Beistelltische are therefore not emitted because every child of theirs is placed elsewhere (19145 Essgruppen is emitted directly as 'Dining Sets'). GERMAN-vs-UK DIVERGENCE: the DE department layout differs from the UK store's (DE has 700675 Tische / 700676 Stuehle / 700319 Sitzbaenke / 16244 Bartische & -stuehle where the UK groups differently), and DE carries six nodes the UK tree does not surface as leaves: 47360 Bartische mit Hocker, 56516 Gamingtisch & -stuhl-Sets, 49079 Regalsysteme fuer Kleidung & Schuhe, 20611 Tritthocker & Trittleitern, 24830 Laptoptische & Laptophalter and 24825 Bettpodeste (the last one excluded). All node names here were translated from the DE store's own wording; nothing was copied from the UK labels.
